title: How To Get Multi User Support In Samsung Galaxy J7/J5 (2016)
description: In this video , i am going to show you how to get multiuser support in samsung galaxy j7 and j7.  Steps: Step 1. Open FileExplorer (Es file explorer, preferable) Step 2. Go to "Device" . Search for "build.prop"   Edit and add the below string at the end of the editor and save and reboot !   fw.max_users=3 fw.show_multiuserui=1   How to  Install Twrp Recovery in Samsung Galaxy J7 ( help to get recovery mode ) :  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6E6SFKwSpAM  How to Install Custom Rom on Samsung Galaxy J7 : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZU1nZmaAHuE  J7 VS S4 Speed Test : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_tUNqwGVdw  *SOCIAL MEDIA * Facebook :  https://www.facebook.com/Trickportal Instagram:  https://instagram.com/himansh95.
